upstream_test_preservation.ready_release_markers: Constructor waits complete ready line, positive acquisition waits Acquired, release waits actual Released; locker.py emits events after the operations. One acquire/release transaction per helper, no diagnostic delay committed.
upstream_test_preservation.limitations: time.time response deadline is not monotonic. Accumulated event output is valid only for the one transaction here; repeated transactions need cursor/generation isolation. Original negative checks retain 0.1s and original timeout sleep(1), and do not prove contender progress under arbitrary delay. These limits are accurately disclosed; AST identity is not a formal equivalence proof.
